project_type: Python CLI extension (plugin subcommands + standalone docopt entry point) that wraps the ICAv2 REST API via wrapica/libica
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml; package manager uv (uv.lock present), pip-compatible. Package layout src/icav2_cli_plugins/. No build/compile step for the Python sources.
test_framework: pytest (>=7,<9) + hypothesis (>=6,<7), declared under [project.optional-dependencies].test in pyproject.toml. Property tests live in tests/ and use the '# Feature: profile-based-config, Property N: ...' tagging convention.
build_command: uv pip install -e . (only needed if dependencies change; not required for source edits)
verification_instructions: Run from the worktree root: `uv run pytest tests/ -p no:orcabus_pipeline_test_utils`. The `-p no:orcabus_pipeline_test_utils` flag is MANDATORY: a stray global pytest11 entrypoint (orcabus_pipeline_test_utils.conftest_plugin) in the shared conda/uv environment otherwise aborts collection with ModuleNotFoundError. To run a subset, add a path or `-k` selector, e.g. `uv run pytest tests/test_config_parser_properties.py -p no:orcabus_pipeline_test_utils`. Do NOT run `src/icav2_cli_plugins/utils/tests/` (one module there has a pre-existing collection error unrelated to this task).
environment_constraints: ALWAYS pass `-p no:orcabus_pipeline_test_utils` to pytest. Do NOT read or write the user's live ~/.icav2-cli-plugins/config; tests use tmp_path. key_patterns: Config file lives at ~/.icav2-cli-plugins/config (globals.CONFIG_FILE_PATH), INI/AWS-style. ConfigParser.parse/serialize/parse_file/write_file handle sections; write_file sets mode 0600. Section name validation uses globals.PROFILE_NAME_REGEX; output_format validated against globals.VALID_OUTPUT_FORMATS ('table','json','yaml'); TOKEN_REFRESH_THRESHOLD=3600. Encryption: utils/api_key_encryption.py uses an 'ENCRYPTED:' prefix (is_encrypted/encrypt_secret/decrypt_secret/resolve_api_key, DEFAULT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH/DEFAULT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH). TokenManager._generate_token POSTs to <base_url>/api/tokens with X-API-Key; _is_token_fresh decodes JWT exp without signature verification. ProfileResolver precedence: ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN/ICAV2_PROJECT_ID/ICAV2_BASE_URL override; --profile / ICAV2_PROFILE select profile; ICAV2_TENANT_NAME backward-compat; else [default]. base_url = https://<server_url>/ica/rest. Project-name->id resolution: config_helpers.get_project_id_from_project_name_curl(base_url, project_name, access_token) and configure_set.Command._resolve_project_id (lists <base_url>/api/projects). Configure subcommands are lazy-imported via configure/__init__.py::CONFIGURE_SUBCOMMANDS and dispatched in utils/cli.py's `cmd == 'configure'` branch (which also has an inline _print_configure_help). Plugin SuperCommand/Command base classes are in subcommands/__init__.py.
directory_structure: src/icav2_cli_plugins/utils/ holds config_parser.py, profile_resolver.py, token_manager.py, api_key_encryption.py, config_helpers.py, tenant_helpers.py, globals.py, cli.py (standalone docopt entry point with COMMAND_MODULE_MAP + lazy dispatch). src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/ holds the configure command group (set, list, generate-keys) with a CONFIGURE_SUBCOMMANDS registry in __init__.py. src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/tokens/ holds the tokens group (export). tests/ holds the pytest + hypothesis suite. The prior single-level spec is at .kiro/specs/profile-based-config/. The wiki is a separate repo at /home/alexiswl/GitHub/UMCCR/icav2-cli-plugins.wiki (Configuration.md, Installation.md, Home.md, commands/, stories/, _Sidebar.md).
